honor.title: Honor AI Space login
honor.description:
Same credentials as Honor ID / AI Space. thing_name (robot device id) is required for Grit honor_card_login — first field of plugin_account token, ends with …bndpiz…. Honor session cookies are stored for automatic JWT refresh.

{error_detail}

honor_captcha.title: Honor ID captcha
honor_captcha.description: A captcha page will open. Complete it — the wizard continues automatically.

honor_sms.title: SMS code
honor_sms.description:
Enter the SMS code sent to {phone_hint}. If nothing arrives, enable «Resend SMS» and submit.

{error_detail}

honor_device.title: Robot device id
honor_device.description:
Grit needs thing_name for honor_card_login (empty → Put_Table_Error). Paste the robot id (e.g. from plugin_account.xml token, first segment before ';').

{error_detail}

login.title: YuGong / Grit account
login.description: RobotCleaner cloud password account (phone without country code). Prefer «Honor AI Space» if you only sign in via Honor ID.

token.title: Cloud token
token.description: Paste JWT or full plugin_account token. thing_name is taken from the token or cloud device list.

honor_after_captcha.title: Signing in…
honor_after_captcha.description: Captcha accepted, signing into Honor / Grit.

error.sms_send_failed: Could not send SMS — see details / Home Assistant log
error.invalid_device: Invalid or missing robot thing_name (device id)
error.captcha_required: Solve the captcha in the browser link first, then continue
error.no_devices: No robots found on this account
error.unknown: Error — see details below / Home Assistant log.

abort.no_devices: No robots found on this account
abort.unknown: Could not continue after captcha. Start setup again.

refresh.title: Token / refresh
refresh.description:
Leave token blank and Submit for Honor silent refresh, or paste a fresh JWT. On failure the exact reason is shown below.

{error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant host cannot reach Grit cloud.
error.invalid_auth: Cloud rejected token/session. Re-login via Honor AI Space or paste a fresh JWT.
error.unknown: Error — see details below / Home Assistant log.
